Gentle turn summary
Handler training shaped the month

The Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways kept service steady and adjusted quickly to changing needs. The senior coordinator guided daily decisions, and the welfare coordinator checked comfort plans before each departure. <<FACT F042>> Staff kept the desk ledger current so that each service change was visible to the whole team.

Passenger preparation improved across the month. The welcome team gave clearer boarding guidance, which reduced last-minute corrections and helped handlers move with less delay. When cases required extra attention, the desk reviewed carrier fit, hydration, and calm handling steps before release to the gate. This kept animal movement orderly and supported a consistent standard of care.

Operational handoffs were also smoother. Dispatch notes were shorter and more precise, and the desk used them to match staffing with likely demand. The team should keep reinforcing these routines, since the strongest results came from early review, clear notes, and steady follow-through.

Next month, the desk should continue training, maintain close ledger discipline, and keep comfort checks central to every acceptance decision.
